All Classes and Interfaces

Class
Description
AbstractFileRepository<ID,E>
Repository that keeps entities in memory (inherited from InMemoryRepository) and mirrors them in a UTF-8 text file, one entity per line.
AbstractService<ID,E,R>
Base class for services that add and remove entities, using the Template Method pattern.
CommunityService
Service that analyzes the network as a graph: users are nodes and friendships are edges.
ConfigurationException
Thrown when the application configuration (config.properties) is missing, cannot be read, or contains a missing or unknown value.
ConsoleUI
Minimal console interface for the social network.
DuplicateEntityException
Thrown when an entity conflicts with an existing one (for example a username that is already taken, or two users who are already friends).
Entity<ID>
Base class for all domain entities.
EntityNotFoundException
Thrown when an operation refers to an entity that does not exist (for example removing a user that is not in the network).
Friendship
A friendship between two users of the network.
FriendshipDbRepository
Skeleton of the database repository for friendships.
FriendshipFileRepository
File repository for friendships.
FriendshipRepository
Repository for friendships, adding queries for all friendships of a user.
FriendshipService
Service for managing friendships between users.
FriendshipValidator
Validates the data of a friendship: both user ids must be present and positive, and a user cannot be friends with themselves.
IdGenerator
Helper for repositories that generate numeric ids themselves (memory and file storage).
InMemoryFriendshipRepository
In-memory repository for friendships.
InMemoryRepository<ID,E>
Repository that keeps entities in a map in memory.
InMemoryUserRepository
In-memory repository for users.
Main
Entry point of the social network application.
Repository<ID,E>
Generic CRUD repository for entities.
RepositoryException
Thrown when the data cannot be read from or written to the storage (for example a file that cannot be opened, or a line with an invalid format).
RepositoryFactory
Creates the repositories of the application (Simple Factory pattern).
RepositoryType
The kinds of persistence the application supports, selected with repository.type in config.properties.
Tuple<A,B>
An immutable pair of two values.
UI
A user interface for the social network.
User
A user of the social network, identified by a numeric id.
UserDbRepository
Skeleton of the database repository for users.
UserFileRepository
File repository for users.
UserRepository
Repository for users, adding queries by username and by email.
UserService
Service for managing the users of the social network.
UserValidator
Validates the data of a user: username, email and password.
ValidationException
Thrown when an entity has invalid data (for example an empty username or a self-friendship).
Validator<T>
Strategy for validating an entity.
